parsed.rationale: One of the two participating records — `ProcessInfo.ThermalState.description` in `Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift` — carries `is_sample_app: true`, which is a restraint marker that dominates any action signal. Although the production-side record `PerformanceControls.thermalStateLabel` in `Shared/Wallpaper/Sources/Wallpaper/DebugUI/ThemeDebugOverlay/PerformanceControls.swift` is unmarked, lifting shared logic between a sample-app debug HUD and a production debug-UI component would couple production semantics to sample-app demonstration code. The Jaccard similarity of 0.75 reflects structural resemblance (both are computed properties mapping `ProcessInfo.ThermalState` to a human-readable label), but that resemblance is the expected consequence of both files serving a debug/diagnostic purpose in parallel contexts, not evidence of unintentional duplication.
